decisions.reason: It remains a low-cost, agency-focused compliance add-on close to the core offer, so the option value of staying in the market is still higher than the cost of carrying it.
We keep it because it is tightly tied to the hosting core and likely cheap to continue offering, but its limited differentiation makes later portfolio pruning a meaningful risk.
It reinforces the firm's security and support positioning for existing hosting customers, and as a close-to-core service extension it is worth keeping while demand and longevity become clearer.
